images.title: One square, two expressions
images.purpose: Shows four equal m by n rectangles around a small square, whose area is (m + n)² − 4mn and also (n − m)².
images.composition: One large square centred, made of four rectangles in a pinwheel around a small square. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: A large square of side m + n made of four equal amber (#E69F00) rectangles, each m by n with n three times m, arranged in a pinwheel so that each rectangle's long side runs along one edge of the large square. In the centre, a small teal (#0072B2) square with side n − m. Labels: 'm' and 'n' on the short and long sides of the top rectangle, 'm + n' along the bottom edge of the large square, 'n − m' beside one side of the small square. Below the figure, centred, the label '(m + n)² − 4mn = (n − m)²'. Exactly 4 rectangles and 1 small square.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Taking away the rectangles and reading the side directly give the same area.
images.description: Shows four equal m by n rectangles around a small square, whose area is (m + n)² − 4mn and also (n − m)².

image_decisions.why: The two methods read the same figure differently; the figure itself is what both expressions describe.
